events.content:
I added the product images to `app/ProductGallery.tsx`. Each product now shows a Next.js `<Image>` with `src={product.imageUrl}`, `alt={product.name}`, `width={300}` and `height={200}`. That matches how `app/page.tsx` shows its hero image: `next/image` with a set width and height. I also removed the TODO comments.

I didn't add `priority` to these images. On the page they come after the hero image, so they can load lazily, which is the default.

I checked the types with `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` and it printed no errors. I didn't run `next build` or look at the page in a browser.

There's no `public/` folder in the repo, so `/product-1.jpg` through `/product-3.jpg` (and `/hero-image.jpg`) will return 404 until those files are added.
